# The appointments Ranginui made — and who is keeping them

The mistake is reading myths as entertainment. Ranginui's cycle reads more like a charter — each story assigning a duty the modern world still pays for.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ranginui
- **Pantheon:** Polynesian
- **Domain of influence:** Sky, Fatherhood, Creation
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 412 of 546

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Solar & Renewable Energy — through *Origins*

Ranginui appears in polynesian tradition as sky, fatherhood, creation.  The name's meaning, "'Great heaven' (Māori rangi 'sky, heavens' + nui 'great'), the sky father prised apart from the earth mother Papatūānuku by their children.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Primary seat: Ranginui embodies sky, fatherhood, creation — the core of solar energy.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

### Aviation & Aerospace — through *Worship and Memory*

Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Ranginui in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Ranginui shares symbolic territory with aviation aerospace.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence — through *Worship and Memory*

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Ranginui shares symbolic territory with storm forecasting.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

The stories of Ranginui place sky, fatherhood, creation at the center of a living mythological world.

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in solar & renewable energy, aviation & aerospace, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it.
